extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is the largest semantic-controlled paired video generation dataset, containing over 100K curated paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions covering 4 primary categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement. It was created by collecting high-quality reference images and using commercial model templates and community LoRAs to generate paired videos.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu (Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
extraction.citeAs: Bian, Y., Chen, X., Li, Z., Zhi, T., Sang, S., Luo, L., & Xu, Q. (2025). Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.20888.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by collecting 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality real images collected from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Paired videos were generated using commercial model APIs (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Reference images were matched to compatible visual-effects templates (some templates restrict subject categories). For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini-2.5-pro, GPT-5 (for semantic alignment scoring); VIDU and Kling (commercial APIs for video generation); community LoRAs (CivitAI)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping. Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data's semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models. Performance degrades when caption descriptions diverge or when subjects differ markedly between reference and target. Multi-reference prompting can cause unwanted blending of visual details across videos.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of unified semantic-controlled video generation models. The dataset supports concept-guided, style-guided, motion-guided, and camera-guided video generation tasks, as well as zero-shot generalization to unseen semantic conditions.
